automations.title: Automations
automations.description: Manage jobs as automations: switch-style enable toggles, create dialog and delete confirmation.
automations.createHint: Creates an underlying job (schedule: cron expression or intervalMs milliseconds).
automations.toggleNote: Toggles are page-local only (the jobs API has no enabled field yet): a disabled automation hides manual triggers here; server-side scheduling is unaffected.
